name: BA Fall Cube Fest 2018

venue.name: Berwick Academy
venue.details: The Competition will be in the large commons area. This is straight up the main enterence.

information: This competition will be held at Berwick Academy in the large commons area. The competitor limit will be 90 competitors. The entry fee will be $15. There will be no luch provided because the are many food places in the area. If this is your first competition we recommend taking a look at the WCA regulations before coming to this competition. The WCA and competitors will not hold Berwick Academy responsible for any damage or injuries caused at the competition.
